messages:
alex: Lumen POC reporting TTFT tail spikes. Median ~280ms but tail up to 3.5-4s when ~100 concurrent connections. Gateway logs show TLS handshake timeouts and some 429s. Demo Tue and they want it stable.

alex: log snippet they pasted:
```
2026-03-20T11:05:12Z TLS handshake timeout from 10.11.5.3
2026-03-20T11:05:13Z 429 rate_limit api_key=lumen-poc-22
request_id=lm-42 latency=3890ms
```

nora: sounds like classic connection churn + batching window interaction. First checks: are they using HTTP keepalive / connection pooling? share api_key so we can pull route metrics.

alex: api_key is lumen-poc-22. They say "managed gateway" so connections look short-lived by default.

ben: triage plan: 1) inspect route metrics (batch_window_ms, avg batch_size, batch_wait_ms) 2) check runtime traces for kv_cache_hit 3) check recent deploys for batching heuristics. Fast mitigation: route override to reduce queueing and keep connections open longer.

ops-bot: deploy 2026-03-19T02:01:05 updated batching.short_seq_heuristic in cluster-central-1 by ci-bot. No rollback on record.

ben: proposed quick overrides for lumen-poc-22:
```
redwood routes update --api-key=lumen-poc-22 \
  --set batch_window_ms=1 \
  --set max_batch_size=12 \
  --set prefix_kv_cache.enabled=true \
  --set prefix_kv_cache.ttl=600 \
  --set edge.keepalive=90s
```
I'll run and watch for 20m.

ops-bot: config-change 2026-03-20T11:22:34 applied: route_override(lumen-poc-22) batch_window_ms=1, max_batch_size=12, prefix_kv_cache.enabled=true ttl=600, edge.keepalive=90s.

alex: customer enabled keepalive on their side. Early numbers: median rose slightly to ~320ms (smaller batches), but 95p improved from ~3.9s -> ~620ms. A few ~1.2s outliers remain.

nora: good reduction. Follow-ups: (a) provide a 6-prompt prefill pack to warm KV cache for core flows, (b) offer a short dedicated burst for the demo window. Rough demo burst estimate: 4 hours dedicated to cover peak ~250 qps ~ $300 (we can offer 4h demo credit). I'll forward SOC2/KMS questions to security.

ben: will monitor batch_size distribution and batch_wait_ms for 24h and escalate to rollback heuristic if regression appears.

alex: will confirm demo acceptance and pricing with customer. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
